basic_info.description: This spectacular Golden Gate Heights home with stunning panoramic ocean view has just completed a full transformation. Modern open kitchen equipped w/Thermador appliances, custom made cabs, beautiful quartz countertop. A spacious vaulted ceiling living room with fireplace, formal dining room, pantry room & 2 bedrooms including a master suite are on the upper level. Lower level features a large family room w/built-in Wet bar, a 2nd master suite with walk-in closet, the 4th bedroom and an office. A separate laundry room in the garage. A tastefully designed cozy & easy to maintain front and back yard with separate automatic irrigation systems. As part of the overall re-design, raised 2nd story ceilings, seismic upgrade, new plumbing, electrical, solar, floor, radiant heat, windows, doors, stucco, roof & deck finishes of the highest quality were put into place.
